notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP (Python requests, real-browser UA) used first for robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and homepage HTML - robots.txt has no Anthropic/Claude/ClaudeBot disallow and allows /collections/ paths (Shopify default), so all tiers were permitted. Homepage HTML server-renders the full desktop mega-menu (<nav class=menu__drop>), giving a reliable category tree via bs4. Product LISTING pages, however, are powered by a client-side Bloomreach Discovery widget (window.bloomreachConfig, core.dxpapi.com) with no product data or counts in the raw HTML, so tier (a) alone could not get quantities. TREE: built from the union of the server-rendered mega-menu (primary source) plus the XML sitemap (sitemap_collections_1.xml, 522 URLs) as a cross-check for missed nodes; sitemap-only orphan collections not linked from the mega-menu or any category subnav (door-mats, outdoor-storage = NO RESULTS FOUND/empty; beach-towels = exact duplicate 7-item set of the nav-linked outdoor-throws-and-beach-towels; shelving-and-storage = 161 items, all case-goods furniture duplicating Furniture.xlsx content; wood-cabinets/glass-cabinets/modular-storage/modular-storage-1 = unlinked material/style variants of furniture cabinets) were excluded as dead/legacy or furniture-duplicate collections, except outdoor-replacement-cushions which had genuine live textile content and was kept at LOW confidence with a flag. QTY: tier (b) Playwright (chromium, headless) confirmed the widget renders an 'N Items' text once hydrated, but rapid sequential navigations in one Playwright session triggered a bot-detection wall ('Sorry, you have been blocked') after the first page - a genuine tier (b) block, so remaining quantities were obtained via tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome (real authenticated Chrome tab, one page at a time with waits) per the escalation rule; every qty below is the exact 'N Items' text rendered on the page plus a breadcrumb check confirming the h1/breadcrumb matched the requested node. EXCLUDED: Rug Pads, Rug/Fabric/Bedding Swatches, Touch-Up Kits, Finish Boards (samples/reference tools, not finished products); Wallpaper (wall covering, not textile); Bath Accents & Decor (124 items, overwhelmingly Lighting/mirrors/bath hardware with only a handful of duplicate towel/bathmat SKUs already captured under Towels & Linens); Trays and Bath Accessories/soap dishes-pumps-tumblers (decorative, not storage per storage.md Sec.24); Hooks & Towel Bars (breadcrumb labels it 'Bath Hardware', contents are towel bars/rings/holders - fixtures, not containers); Bar Storage (breadcrumb Dining > Bar Cabinets, i.e. Furniture department, bar cabinets/carts); Tables & Storage / Cabinets / Bookcases & Shelving / Media Consoles / Entryway (Living-menu Furniture department, case-goods already in Furniture.xlsx); Poufs (Furniture/ottoman seating). Two nav leaves (Outdoor Pillows & Poufs, Faux Fur) mix a small number of non-textile furniture items (poufs / a faux-fur chair) into an otherwise textile listing - kept at the site's exact displayed qty per the no-aggregation rule, flagged MEDIUM. Pillow/Duvet Inserts (fill, not fabric-covered finished product) kept at MEDIUM per textile.md Sec.22 ambiguity guidance.
